verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly markets built-in Context and Stores as sufficient for global state without third-party libraries (solid-gh-2), backed by automatic dependency tracking and fine-grained reactivity primitives (solid-gh-1, solid-gh-10). Community testimonials corroborate the reactivity model works well in practice for state management (solid-comm-10, solid-comm-17), though some note rough edges in ergonomics (solid-comm-16). Missing for 10: independent deep-dive documentation specifically on Stores API for complex global state patterns, and no direct hands-on comparison confirming it fully replaces libraries like Redux/Zustand in large apps.
